# `smelt.document`

<!-- Auto-generated by `cargo xtask gen-lua-docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Availability:** Everywhere, including headless mode.

**Advanced:** Low-level building block for plugins that need full control. It may change more freely than the rest of the API.

Indexed read-only documents shared by native data providers and Lua-created windows.

## `smelt.document.text`

```lua
fun(text: string): smelt.document.Document
```

Types: [`smelt.document.Document`](types.md#smeltdocumentdocument)

Index plain text once without creating a Lua table or buffer line per row. Attach the result with `win:document(source)` for viewport-only rendering and Vim navigation.
